name: Qeuph (QUH) Quantum-Resistant Cryptocurrency
description: A post-quantum proof-of-work blockchain: ML-DSA-87 (FIPS 204) lattice signatures, double SHA3-512 proof of work, Bech32m addresses, a UTXO + txnonce ledger, two-thirding emission capped at 31,500,000 QUH, an encrypted seed wallet, JSON-RPC, a CLI and a node explorer UI. The whole node suite is Python with no mandatory third-party dependencies.
author: Qeuph contributors
